decisions.rationale: The draft is useful as an internal proof that the writing harness can move from source packet to critique repair. Loop 38 added a public-facing before/after writing artifact, Loop 39 added a real revision trace from this draft's own opening, Loop 40 added a cold-reader red-pen test, Loop 41 added a one-minute paragraph autopsy form, Loop 42 added a private HTML review artifact, Loop 43 added rendered screenshot proof for that private review surface, Loop 44 used that artifact for an editorial-system critique, Loop 45 revised the private draft against that critique, Loop 46 tightened the revised draft by removing a repeated weak-paragraph block and replacing stale prior-loop phrasing, Loop 47 judged the current draft ready for human promotion review while still not public-ready, Loop 49 added a reference-blogger readiness gate, Loop 50 added a review-desk protocol that turns vague style review into source, decision, artifact, and reject-condition fields, Loop 51 surfaced that protocol in the private HTML review artifact, Loop 52 created a current-hash human promotion review packet, and Loop 53 made the remaining real-evidence blocker explicit. The draft now opens with a reader-recognizable bad AI paragraph, adds a real-time editorial rejection moment, sharpens the AutoAgent comparison into a harness-to-harness mapping, adds an inline visual-proof table, gives the reader a concrete review protocol for their own drafts, and admits that synthetic examples are not enough for public promotion. It still needs human critique, real failed-draft/session evidence, public rendered candidate proof, public image contract promotion, and final hash approval before this can become a public approval candidate.
requiredNextActions: Send the current private draft, rendered HTML review artifact, and human promotion review packet to human promotion review.
